title: Misinformation, Trust & Polarization
description: Studying how false beliefs form and persist, how institutional trust erodes, and how information environments shape attitudes and behavior. Recent work examines gamified tools, AI-mediated conversations, and messengers to improve belief accuracy and reduce polarization.

title: Well-being
description: Exploring how factors like motivation, affect, and social connection shape learning, expertise development, and human flourishing. This work includes mixed-methods research on general and financial wellbeing, and interventions that support sustained engagement and growth.

title: Sustainability
description: Testing interventions to shift environmentally relevant behaviors, including transportation mode use and climate-related decision-making through incentives, disincentives, and framing.
